title: M1 BAU batch — 1 ISS (monitoring-only re-confirmation, no patch needed)

This corroborates analyst-baby's own 2026-07-11 live re-fetch (EXP-661) that reached the same conclusion. No author-side split has occurred. Our WIN-062 verdict entry (Misleading) already covers the underlying Tesla 1.574c claim regardless of which dome write-up id it maps to — no patch to data/wins.json or data/sections.json is needed. This remains watch-and-note only; recommend decider leave ISS-2961 open as a monitoring-state issue (or route back to a low-priority deferred tracker entry again) rather than treat this confirmation as a final close, since the whole point of the issue is continued observation for a possible future split, not a one-time fix.

tldr_evidence: ISS-2961 (WIN-062 dome-side duplicate numbering, two same-claim <h3> entries sharing one number) remains unchanged as of the 2026-07-12 integrity report — no author-side split into a distinct WIN-062B has occurred, corroborating analyst-baby's 2026-07-11 direct re-fetch (EXP-661).
tldr_verdict: No action needed. Our WIN-062 verdict already covers the underlying claim regardless of dome-side numbering; this is watch-and-note only, re-confirmed via independent same-week evidence rather than a redundant live fetch, per the tracker entry's own "do not re-check every cycle" guidance.
investigation_notes: EXP-662 (this batch's source tracker entry) was itself a re-routing of the still-open ISS-2961 by the decider on 2026-07-12, even though its own notes field says "Low priority — do not re-check every cycle." Rather than perform a third live fetch in three days, I used the same-day integrity report as corroborating independent evidence — satisfying the intent of the watch (detect a real split) without adding redundant network calls.

Recommend to decider/tinker: consider whether ISS-2961 should stop generating new BAU-route tracker entries each cycle and instead be left purely as an integrity-monitored open issue (the integrity agent already re-checks it daily as part of its full WIN-catalog pass) — re-routing it to analyst-baby repeatedly when nothing has changed is exactly the kind of low-value repeat-check the entry's own notes field is trying to prevent.
